title: nca biophysics-frozen interval magnitude sweep (LOCAL, load-bearing half of P13)
scope: LOCAL only. Settles whether the nca_block current MAGNITUDE matters to the worm quorum, independent of the Greene SOL27 ESMFold/structure half. Does NOT wait on Greene.

foundation.operator: V1 rank-2 (P18 certified): QF=G(total_pa, snare_factor); total_pa = alpha * sum_{non-SNARE classes}(-sat_pa*engagement).
foundation.nca_role: nca_block is one of the 7 worm mechanism classes; its sat_pa scalar is DEFAULT_PER_CLASS_PA_AT_SATURATION['nca_block'] (legacy 40 pA). It sums into total_pa (it is NOT the SNARE multiplicative coordinate).
foundation.passing_subset_definition: Stage-1 halothane subset is a PASS iff Hill-fit predicted EC50 gives max(pred/pub, pub/pred) <= 2.0, pub=340 uM worm, frozen alpha=0.13, doses=[10,30,100,200,350,500,1000,3000] uM, seeds=[42,137,219,331,443], 30s LIF sims. This pass criterion is REUSED unchanged from v7_subset_search (PREREG_HASH 533b624a...).
foundation.nca_quorum_subsets: The 64 worm subsets (of 127) that CONTAIN nca_block. (2^6 = 64, confirmed empirically.)

interval_derivation.formula: I_block(block_fraction) = block_fraction * g_leak * D = block_fraction * 150.0 pA
interval_derivation.rationale: block_fraction in [0.5,0.8] = a substantial-but-incomplete NALCN/NCA leak block. 40 pA legacy maps to bf=0.267, BELOW the lo edge, so the interval cannot be accused of trivially bracketing the hand-set legacy value.

baseline_reference.baseline_universality: All 15 baseline-passing nca subsets contain SNARE; 14/15 also contain Complex-I. SNARE-OR-ComplexI universality holds at baseline (15/15).
baseline_reference.note: Baseline is RE-READ from the frozen artifact; not re-simulated. G2 compares the re-sim at nca=75 pA against this frozen baseline count.

design.what_is_re_simulated: 64 nca-containing worm subsets, 8 doses, 5 seeds = 2560 LIF sims at nca=75 pA (lo edge of the interval). Each sim already returns all 3 endpoints, so '64 subsets x 3 endpoints' = these 2560 sims read out on 3 metrics.
design.primary_endpoint_for_pass: quiescent_fraction (drives Hill EC50 + pass, identical to v7_subset_search). command/network rates are the leak-screen + diagnostic endpoints.
design.edge_choice: nca=75 pA is the WORST-CASE (lo) edge: smallest magnitude in the interval, hence the strongest test of whether the quorum survives. If 75 pA survives, the whole [75,120] interval survives a fortiori (monotone hyperpolarizing). 120 pA (hi) is a confirmatory secondary run.
design.nonlinear: QF is a nonlinear LIF readout of total_pa; cannot be recomputed arithmetically from the baseline -> a real re-sim is required.
design.override_mechanism: NEW code path patches ONLY DEFAULT_PER_CLASS_PA_AT_SATURATION['nca_block'] in-process at run start. Frozen operator apply_anesthetic is NOT edited. All 7 non-nca entries are left untouched and asserted byte-identical (G3).

G1_interval_provenance.statement: The interval [75,120] pA is the closed form block_fraction*g_leak*D of the FROZEN disk constants, byte-identical on re-derivation from scripts/brain/lif_brain.py.
G1_interval_provenance.pass_rule: Re-parsed (tau,C_mem,v_rest,v_thr) yield g_leak=10.0 nS, D=15.0 mV, g_leak*D=150.0 pA EXACTLY; 0.5*150=75.0 and 0.8*150=120.0 EXACTLY; legacy 40 pA -> bf 0.26667 < 0.5.
G1_interval_provenance.fail_rule: Any constant differs from frozen value, OR 75/120 not reproduced exactly, OR legacy 40 pA lands inside [75,120].

G2_quorum_survival.statement: At nca=75 pA, the number of passing nca-containing subsets is >= 80% of the frozen baseline count (15), AND SNARE-OR-ComplexI universality holds (every passing nca subset contains SNARE or Complex-I).
G2_quorum_survival.pass_rule: n_passing_75pA >= ceil(0.8*15) = 12  AND  every 75 pA-passing nca subset contains snare_cooperativity OR complex_i_block.
G2_quorum_survival.fail_rule: n_passing_75pA < 12  (the quorum was resting on the hand-set 40 pA scalar -> DEFLATE the nca contribution),  OR universality broken (a passing subset relies on neither SNARE nor Complex-I).
G2_quorum_survival.accept_either_way: PASS => nca magnitude is robust across the biophysically-derived interval, the quorum does not depend on the legacy hand-set value. FAIL => honest deflation: report that nca's quorum membership was scalar-dependent; the magnitude DOES matter and is uncalibratable (NALCN no Kd) -> Tier4-adjacent parked residue.

G3_substitution_leak_screen.statement: The 7 non-nca per-class scalars are byte-identical between the baseline operator and the nca-override run; only nca_block changed.
G3_substitution_leak_screen.pass_rule: sha256 of the non-nca scalar dict == 54788ddcf622669910f9f6738d8b84167346a3e80f96c1982c26d345388c5478 in BOTH baseline and override processes; nca_block == 75.0 in override, 40.0 in baseline.
G3_substitution_leak_screen.fail_rule: Any non-nca scalar mutated by the override path (leak), OR the override failed to set nca_block to 75.0.

additional_fast_preconditions.build_rank_smoke: A 1-subset x 2-dose x 1-seed smoke re-sim runs to completion under nca=75 pA in the ml env (harness wiring works).
additional_fast_preconditions.bit_identical_regression: When nca override is set BACK to 40.0 (legacy), one smoke sim is bit-identical to the frozen-operator baseline path (proves the NEW code path is a pure scalar swap, not a behavior change).

heavy_run.what: 64 nca-containing worm subsets x 8 doses x 5 seeds = 2560 LIF sims at nca=75 pA (primary) [+ optional 2560 at 120 pA confirmatory].

non_destructive_guarantees: No edits to phase_g_state_validator.apply_anesthetic or any frozen operator.
No edits to v7_* ensembles or their frozen artifacts.
Override is an in-process scalar patch in a NEW module; baseline artifact v7_stage1_halothane.csv is read-only.
All new artifacts under artifacts/p13_sol28/ ; all audit docs under audits/phase1/P13-SOL28/.
